facts.business: Kopran Limited operates through two complementary pharmaceutical business verticals comprising Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Formulations, developing active pharmaceutical ingredients and manufacturing high-quality finished dosage forms across the pharmaceutical value chain.
key_risks: Volatility in prices of raw materials (especially Amoxicillin Trihydrate) impacting inventory valuation
Foreign currency risk on imported raw materials
Recoverability of overdue trade receivables requiring significant judgement for allowance estimation
